name: Shirtmasters
old_description: We put quality and care before all else ensuring that our clients have what they need to outfit their employees, look good on a family vacation or promote their event in a memorable way.
about:
Shirtmasters operates from Chichester, New Hampshire, just outside Concord. The company has been in the industry for over 30 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

Shirtmasters provides custom screen printing and embroidery services, producing decorated apparel and promotional items for a range of clients. The company runs in-house screen printing and embroidery departments, supported by a graphic design team and a customer service system designed for quality, efficiency, and accuracy. Specific facility size, employee count, and annual production volumes are not disclosed.

The company serves sports teams, corporations, municipalities, schools and universities, small businesses, and restaurants. Its customer base extends from the Concord, New Hampshire area to clients nationwide, including as far as Anchorage, Alaska.

Shirtmasters differentiates itself through a focus on quality and personal service, offering a consultative approach rather than automated online ordering. The company cites typical turnaround times of two weeks or less for most of the year, a selection of over 100 apparel brands, and a mission that emphasizes environmental consciousness and community support.

name: Shore Customs Car and Truck Accessories
old_description: Shore Customs is the Jersey Shore’s Premier Source for Professional Car & Truck Customization
about:
Shore Customs Car and Truck Accessories operates in Ocean Township, New Jersey, serving the Jersey Shore region as a vehicle customization shop. The business focuses on professional car and truck customization, offering a range of installation and detailing services.

The shop provides services including 3M ceramic coating, window tinting, paint protection film, auto detailing, audio and electronics installation, remote start systems, lift kits, rim repairs, vinyl wraps, and truck accessories such as tonneau covers, bed liners (Rhino Linings), and seating upgrades (Katzkin leather). They also offer powder coating, radar detectors, and weather protection products. Operations are conducted from a showroom facility where customers can view products and receive project reports detailing services performed.

Customers are primarily individual vehicle owners seeking customization for Jeeps, trucks, and daily drivers. The shop caters to off-road enthusiasts with lift kits and Front Runner outfitting, as well as truck owners needing towing accessories, shelving, and bed protection. They also serve clients looking for interior upgrades like heated leather seats and remote start systems.

The company emphasizes transparent communication and step-by-step work processes, providing clients with detailed project reports and a satisfaction guarantee. Financing options up to $10,000 are available for larger projects.

name: Sider's Woodcrafting
old_description: Please contact us if you cannot find what you are looking for!
about:
Sider's Woodcrafting operates from a home-based workshop in Brewer, Maine. The company was founded in October 2015 by Bruce and Mary Graybill after the birth of their first child prompted Bruce to start making cutting boards as holiday gifts using a table saw and belt sander. What began as a personal project quickly expanded when a friend requested eleven more boards, turning the effort into a family-owned business.

The workshop produces handcrafted end-grain chopping blocks, cutting boards in various sizes, charcuterie boards, specialty shapes such as cribbage boards and guitar-shaped boards, and epoxy-resin coasters and clipboards. Each piece is made from a mix of domestic and exotic woods chosen to highlight natural color and grain, with epoxy accents using SUPERCLEAR epoxy. In its first full year of operation (2016), the shop completed just under 400 boards.

The company sells directly to consumers through its online store, serving home cooks, gift buyers, and woodworking enthusiasts. Products range from small cheese boards to two-foot-long "mega" cutting boards, with designs that double as functional kitchen tools and decorative items.

The Graybills emphasize that every item leaves their shop as a functional work of art, backed by a commitment to stand behind their craftsmanship. The business grew from a desire to create everyday objects that showcase the beauty of wood while maintaining a hands-on, small-scale approach.

name: Sierra Components Inc
old_description: Sierra Components adds Component Design, Packaging and more to our list of services.
about:
Sierra Components Inc. (SCI) was founded in 1992 in Minden, Nevada, as a small family-run business. The company began with only a fax machine, a flow hood, and several nitrogen boxes, and has since grown into a multi-million-dollar distribution and processing facility specializing in silicon wafers and bare die. The president and founder brings over 40 years of bare-die distribution experience and 42-plus years in the microelectronics industry.

Today SCI operates as a value-added processor and distributor for the microelectronics and semiconductor sectors. Its services include visual inspection to MIL-STD-883 Method 2010 and MIL-STD-750 Methods 2072/2073, element evaluation and lot qualification to MIL-PRF-38534D (Levels H and K) and MIL-PRF-19500, alternate sourcing for obsolete or unavailable components, and wafer processing such as SAW sorting, inspection, and wafer probing. The company also manages surplus inventory programs that guarantee customers at least 50 percent of book value. A partnership with Kooker Technologies extends the offering to component design, packaging, and substrate fabrication with fast turnaround times.

SCI serves customers in the microelectronics, semiconductor, and defense-related industries that require qualified bare die, silicon wafers, and rigorous inspection and qualification services. Its client base includes organizations needing MIL-STD and MIL-PRF compliant processing, alternate component research, and inventory recovery solutions.

The company emphasizes personal service—no automated attendants—and a commitment to the highest standards of quality, reliability, and customer attention. Its positioning as “large enough to accomplish the task, and small enough to deliver personal attention” reflects a deliberate focus on responsive, relationship-driven support.

name: Signet Plastics
old_description: Precision plastic manufacturing with over 30 years of experience
about:
Founded in 1996 in Maryville, Tennessee, Signet Plastics has built over three decades of experience as a processor of plastic components. The company began as a plastics processor and has accumulated over 30 years of industry experience.

The shop specializes in custom plastic injection molding, including overmolding, hot stamping, and pad printing. It also offers tooling and part design, assembly, and secondary operations, supported by quality and process control systems.

Signet serves manufacturers in automotive, medical, consumer, and industrial sectors, delivering precision molded components for a range of applications.

The company emphasizes service excellence and a commitment to exceeding customer expectations, citing its seasoned team as its greatest asset and positioning itself as a partner in customer success.
